decisions.reason: A roadmap for the shelves and the crawler is a change of direction that only the owner may make, and the plan already says so in its Candidate line; the two earlier plans of this work were approved by the owner with the same line. I report the finding to the owner and do not create a roadmap.

The plan now refuses an also when best is none, and defines the rule for none on either side, the denominator of every figure and the field figure over books where both are shelves, with the interval method.
The plan now saves and hashes a manifest of the eligible population with the card generation and text hash of each book before the draw, and the draw works from the manifest alone.

The plan now makes a reserve of five books of each kind, replaces a dropped book by the next of its kind, allows at most five drops, forbids drops after the send, and makes any added book or larger change an amendment needing new approval.

The sheet no longer shows the model choice, the embedding rank or any score, the order is shuffled by the seed, a test checks that nothing reveals them, and the marks are final before any comparison and never changed after it.

The interval is now a rough guide for the books judged, the whole drawn cohort with every drop and skip and its reason is reported, and a sensitivity figure counts skipped books as wrong; if the readings differ the bar is read as not met.
